chapters.caption_en: Early editors write the war as a freedom war — vapaussota — a liberation from the east.
In 2009, editors begin replacing 'freedom war' with more neutral wording. The old name becomes a ghost.
A careful sentence returns: the war has been called many names, depending on who was speaking.
By 2014, sisällissota — civil war — is the established name on the page Wikipedia shows today.
